title: Geometry showcase

chrome.derived: n 14, standard preset, default density: margin 36 from the brief's 1208 × 1528 usable area on its 1280 × 1600 canvas, gutter G = M/2 = 12, pad d = 5q = 20, radius R = d + 2q = 28, title gap d/2 − I = 4, specimen gap d = 20, caption gap I = 6. Re-derive with derive.mjs --containers --card 5 at another n or density. Grid paper: minor 2q = 8, major 8q = h = 32, ruled from the content edge.

acceptance: Every specimen length comes from derive.mjs; no invented lengths (brief: Geometry).
One construction annotation inside an existing entry names slot, inset, control height and the concentric radius relation.
Type: all 16 roles at their true size and line height, each noted with size, line height and the line height in q; no typeface is prescribed, and no role is scaled.
Space: the six gaps (d, d/2, 2I, I, g_c, 0) and the four paddings (card d, popover ¾d, dialog 1½d, panel 2I), each marked at its true length and named.
Dialog and alert dialog at the popover width 80q; menus and the combobox list at content width up to 80q, the tooltip up to 60q.
Text at T = 2I in controls, menu rows, list rows and table edge cells; one left edge for everything else (mark exceptions [data-inset]).
Static: no operable controls, no interactive roles, nothing in the tab order.
